method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: On the fence out his politics read contextually as about his politics; English unchanged.

revisions.source: I am the President of the United States and we should exploit that fact. Show me presiding over the Bicentennial, meeting with Queen Elizabeth, and generally looking like a President. My record speaks for itself.
revisions.zh: 我是美国总统，我们应充分利用这一点。展示我主持建国二百周年纪念活动、会见伊丽莎白女王，以及其他体现总统风范的场面。我的政绩不言自明。

revisions.source: We barely defeated Ronald Reagan to win our nomination in the first place. We should take conservative positions and make sure we shore up our support in that area.
revisions.zh: 我们当初只是勉强击败罗纳德·里根，才赢得提名。我们应采取保守立场，确保巩固这方面的支持。

revisions.source: Who is this Jimmy Carter person anyway? He's untested and takes both sides of every important issue. We need to make sure people understand that.
revisions.zh: 这个吉米·卡特到底是谁？他未经考验，在每个重要问题上都两边讨好。我们必须让人们明白这一点。

revisions.source: I'm an approachable, open guy with an open Administration. Let's emphasize my mainstream values and positions, and avoid extremist rhetoric or attacks on Jimmy Carter.
revisions.zh: 我是个平易近人、坦率的人，领导着一个开放的政府。我们应强调我符合主流的价值观和立场，避免极端言辞或攻击吉米·卡特。

revisions.source: I will let the cameras into the White House so the people can see for themselves. I'm a normal, approachable, friendly President. I didn't spend my whole life trying to run for the office.
revisions.zh: 我会让摄像机进入白宫，让人民亲眼看看。我是个普通、平易近人、友善的总统，并没有一辈子都在谋划竞选这个职位。

revisions.source: I've taken our country and led it past the nightmares of Watergate and Vietnam. Anyone can see that I've led an open, honest Administration.
revisions.zh: 我已经带领国家走出水门事件和越南战争的噩梦。谁都看得出，我领导的是一个公开、诚实的政府。

revisions.source: Honesty and integrity is one thing, but voters want to hear about solutions. I've led our economy back from a steep recession while passing a tax cut for the American people.
revisions.zh: 诚实与廉正是一回事，但选民想听的是解决办法。我已经带领经济走出严重衰退，同时为美国人民实行了减税。

revisions.source: What about the honesty and integrity of Jimmy Carter? Whether it's abortion, gun control, busing, or labor, he's taken both sides of too many issues to count.
revisions.zh: 那吉米·卡特的诚实与廉正呢？不论堕胎、枪支管制、校车接送还是劳工，他在太多问题上两边都说过好话，多得数不清。

revisions.source: I agree. We can't have this kind of thing on the Ford Administration. He should leave immediately.
revisions.zh: 我同意。福特政府不能容忍这种事情。他应立即离职。

revisions.source: Let's have him leave the day that the article comes out. That way the connection is clear.
revisions.zh: 让他在文章发表当天离职吧。这样，两件事的关系就很清楚了。

revisions.source: Let's wait and see and how the public reacts to this.
revisions.zh: 先等等，看看公众会怎么反应。

revisions.source: A couple of bad jokes shouldn't ruin someone's career. Let's keep him on board.
revisions.zh: 几个糟糕的笑话，不应该毁掉一个人的职业生涯。让他留下吧。

revisions.source: Not really. I'm the President and Carter is an upstart from Georgia. Let's keep it that way.
revisions.zh: 不太想。我是总统，卡特只是佐治亚州来的新晋人物。还是维持这个局面吧。

revisions.source: I think this is a good idea, and we need something to shake this campaign up.
revisions.zh: 我认为这是个好主意，我们也需要一些事情来改变竞选局势。

revisions.source: This is an issue that has been blown way out of proportion. In many of these cases, I've proposed my own alternative to a given bill, and Congress has acted on it.
revisions.zh: 这个问题被严重夸大了。在许多情况下，我都为有关法案提出过自己的替代方案，而国会也采取了行动。

revisions.source: The Democrats, with their huge majorities, have passed bill after bill outside of the American mainstream. I've been left with little choice.
revisions.zh: 民主党凭借庞大的多数，一部接一部通过偏离美国主流的法案。我几乎别无选择。

revisions.source: Congress is simply too liberal to be a useful partner in government right now. I hope that the American people will elect Republican congressman to be my partners over the next four years.
revisions.zh: 眼下，国会过于自由派，无法成为有用的执政伙伴。我希望美国人民选出共和党议员，在未来四年与我合作。

revisions.source: The American people deserve to hear the truth. I support this strategy.
revisions.zh: 美国人民有权听到真相。我支持这个策略。

revisions.source: Maybe some limited spots, asking if we really know who Jimmy Carter is. Or attacking him on one of these issues. But let's not go overboard.
revisions.zh: 或许可以做一些有限的短广告，问问我们是否真的了解吉米·卡特，或就其中某个议题攻击他。但不要过火。

revisions.source: The problem is, if we go negative against Carter, he's sure to hammer us on the Nixon pardon. We really have a lot to lose here.
revisions.zh: 问题是，如果我们对卡特发动负面攻势，他肯定会拿赦免尼克松来猛攻我们。我们在这里确实有很大风险。

revisions.source: This is great. We need any good news we can get at this point.
revisions.zh: 太好了。眼下，只要是好消息，我们都需要。

revisions.source: I will hold a press conference and remind people that we really don't know anything about this guy. What other hidden, perverse notions does he have?
revisions.zh: 我会召开记者会，提醒人们，我们其实对这个人一无所知。他还有什么隐而不露、反常的想法？

revisions.source: Bob Dole is a staunch conservative who really sets the tone for the direction I want to take.
revisions.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是坚定的保守派，真正体现了我想要前进的方向。

revisions.source: Bob Dole is the type of Republican that the entire party can get behind, and he has served his home state of Kansas well.
revisions.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是全党都能支持的共和党人，也为家乡堪萨斯州尽心服务。

revisions.source: This is probably your best strategy. The voters like Carter for now, but hopefully some will think twice about his leadership as election day approaches.
revisions.zh: 这大概是你最好的策略。选民眼下喜欢卡特，但希望随着选举日临近，有些人会重新考虑他的领导能力。

revisions.source: Reagan's supporters are just a vocal minority right now. It's good to unite the party, but will this really help you beat Jimmy Carter in 1976?
revisions.zh: 里根的支持者目前只是声音很大的少数派。团结全党固然好，但这真的有助于你在1976年击败吉米·卡特吗？

revisions.source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence out his politics or readiness for office.
revisions.zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特很冒险。选民喜欢他的为人，甚至包括一些对他的政治主张或任职准备仍然犹豫的人。

revisions.source: This is a good strategy. You need to make the case that you've also acted with integrity in office, given the climate of this year's election.
revisions.zh: 这是个好策略。鉴于今年选举的氛围，你必须说明，自己执政时同样坚守了廉正。

revisions.source: This is out of step with the current mood. Voters do want to hear about honesty and integrity.
revisions.zh: 这与当前情绪不符。选民确实想听到诚实与廉正。

revisions.source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence about his politics or readiness for office.
revisions.zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特很冒险。选民喜欢他的为人，甚至包括一些对他的政治主张或任职准备仍然犹豫的人。

revisions.source: This is a good, proactive step that helped minimize the damage from Butz's gaffe.
revisions.zh: 这是积极而明智的一步，有助于尽量减轻巴茨失言造成的损害。

revisions.source: The reaction is not too good, overall. You quickly decide that Butz must go, but you got a couple days of embarrassing press first.
revisions.zh: 总体而言，反应不太好。你很快决定巴茨必须离职，但在此之前，已经有了几天令人尴尬的报道。

revisions.source: Eventually, after a few days of uproar, your party makes it clear that Butz must go. Unfortunately, this has been a huge distraction and has made you look pretty bad on the evening news.
revisions.zh: 闹了几天之后，党内最终明确表示，巴茨必须离职。不幸的是，这件事严重分散了竞选精力，也让你在晚间新闻里显得很糟。

revisions.source: You need any help you can get right now. Why would you not want to debate on national television?
revisions.zh: 眼下，你需要一切可能的帮助。为什么不想在全国电视上辩论？

revisions.source: You performed pretty well in these debates. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
revisions.zh: 你在这些辩论中的表现相当不错。而且，随着选举临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视局势……

revisions.source: You performed well, except for an unfortunate gaffe about the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
revisions.zh: 除了关于苏联和东欧的一次不幸口误，你的表现不错。而且，随着选举临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视局势……

revisions.source: It is true that relations with Congress have been stormy. But what else can you expect when the House is mostly Democrat, and you're a Republican?
revisions.zh: 你与国会的关系确实风波不断。不过，众议院大多是民主党人，你却是共和党人，还能指望什么？

revisions.source: This is a nice thing to hope for, but for the moment there are a lot of popular Democratic Congressmen in states that you need to win. Tactfulness might be the better strategy.
revisions.zh: 这个愿望当然不错，但眼下，你需要赢下的州里，有许多受欢迎的民主党众议员。措辞圆融一点，或许是更好的策略。

revisions.source: The attacks do stick a little bit, but the issue of your Nixon pardon always lingers in the background.
revisions.zh: 这些攻击多少起了作用，但赦免尼克松的问题始终在背后挥之不去。

revisions.source: This is probably the best strategy. A few attacks on legitimate issues, but not so many that your campaign looks petty and negative.
revisions.zh: 这大概是最好的策略。针对实际议题作一些攻击，但不要多到让竞选显得琐碎、负面。

revisions.source: Fair enough. This doesn't really hurt you, but you need things to break your way fast if you're going to catch up with Carter.
revisions.zh: 也有道理。这并不会真的伤害你，但如果想追上卡特，你需要局势迅速转向对你有利。

revisions.source: This is a no-brainer. Just sit back and let Carter shoot himself in the foot.
revisions.zh: 这不用动脑筋。坐着看卡特搬起石头砸自己的脚就行。

revisions.source: Voters are talking about Carter's poor judgment in doing a Playboy interview -- and about your weird, awkward attempt to pile on...
revisions.zh: 选民在议论卡特接受《花花公子》采访的糟糕判断，也在议论你趁机追打时那种奇怪、尴尬的表现……

revisions.source: Bob Dole is an unexpected choice for running mate, but it could work out well this fall.
revisions.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是出人意料的搭档选择，但在秋季可能会有好效果。

revisions.source: You have selected Howard Baker as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
revisions.zh: 你选择了霍华德·贝克作为竞选搭档。能再谈谈这项选择吗？

revisions.source: Howard Baker knows how to get things done in Washington, and he has always fought hard for the Republican agenda.
revisions.zh: 霍华德·贝克懂得如何在华盛顿把事情办成，也始终为共和党的议程奋力工作。

revisions.source: Howard Baker has served his home state of Tennessee well, and he is the best man for the job.
revisions.zh: 霍华德·贝克为家乡田纳西州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

revisions.source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side.
revisions.zh: 霍华德·贝克是个值得与你并肩的人。

revisions.source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side. Just don't expect him to help much in Tennessee against a guy like Carter.
revisions.zh: 霍华德·贝克是个值得与你并肩的人。只是别指望面对卡特这样的对手，他能在田纳西州帮上太多。

revisions.source: You have selected John Anderson as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
revisions.zh: 你选择了约翰·安德森作为竞选搭档。能再谈谈这项选择吗？

revisions.source: Ronald Reagan and some of his allies can't hide their disappointment in your running mate, and some of them are even saying Carter is better than a Ford-Anderson Administration. Do you have any comment?
revisions.zh: 罗纳德·里根和他的一些盟友，掩饰不住对你搭档选择的失望，甚至有人说卡特也比福特—安德森政府更好。你有什么评论？

revisions.source: Betty Ford is out there making some pretty bold statements about sexuality, marijuana, and other topics. Conservatives want to know if you can have a quiet chat with her to tone it down a bit.
revisions.zh: 贝蒂·福特正在公开谈论性、大麻等话题，言论颇为大胆。保守派想知道，你能否私下与她谈谈，让她收敛一点。

revisions.source: I've tried to explain to her that we have an election coming up, and we don't need all this bad press, but she won't listen.
revisions.zh: 我已经试着向她解释，大选临近，我们不需要这些负面报道，但她不肯听。

revisions.source: What do you want me to say? She's my wife. Can't people find something better to worry about?
revisions.zh: 你们想让我说什么？她是我妻子。难道大家就找不到更值得担心的事吗？

revisions.source: My wife's public approval rating is something like 75%. I wish I had her touch with the media.
revisions.zh: 我妻子的公众支持率好像有75%。真希望我也有她应对媒体的本领。

revisions.source: John Anderson always speaks his mind and fights for what he believes in. These are the kind of people we need in my next Administration.
revisions.zh: 约翰·安德森始终直言自己的想法，为信念而奋斗。我的下届政府正需要这样的人。

revisions.source: John Anderson has served his home state of Illinois well, and he is the best man for the job.
revisions.zh: 约翰·安德森为家乡伊利诺伊州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

revisions.source: John Anderson is a lifelong Republican and he has the right views on all the important issues for our country. We need a guy like him if we hope to win the independent voters away from Jimmy Carter.
revisions.zh: 约翰·安德森终身都是共和党人，对国家所有重要问题都有正确看法。如果我们希望从吉米·卡特那里争取独立选民，就需要他这样的人。

revisions.source: I think if Ronald Reagan hopes for a future in this party, he'd better toe the party line when it comes to our election this fall.
revisions.zh: 我认为，如果罗纳德·里根希望在本党有前途，就最好在今年秋季选举中遵守党的路线。

revisions.source: Anderson is an interesting choice. Let's see how it works out.
revisions.zh: 安德森是个有意思的选择。看看效果如何吧。

revisions.source: Your base is a bit deflated at the choice of Anderson. There's no other way to really put it. Let's hope you can win the Midwest this fall to compensate.
revisions.zh: 选择安德森，让基本盘有些泄气。这实在没有别的说法。希望你秋季能赢下中西部，作为补偿。

revisions.source: Reagan has a substantial following among Republicans, and you should probably be more diplomatic when you talk about him.
revisions.zh: 里根在共和党人中有相当多的追随者，谈到他时，你或许应该更圆融一些。

revisions.source: You have selected John Connally as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
revisions.zh: 你选择了约翰·康纳利作为竞选搭档。能再谈谈这项选择吗？

revisions.source: John Connally has served his home state of Texas well, and he is the best man for the job.
revisions.zh: 约翰·康纳利为家乡得克萨斯州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

revisions.source: Connally was a loyal Democrat for many years, but anyone can see how their party has lurched away from the mainstream. I think he can remind Americans that Republicans are the sensible, governing party in this country.
revisions.zh: 康纳利曾忠于民主党多年，但谁都看得出，民主党已经猛然偏离主流。我认为，他能提醒美国人：共和党才是这个国家理性、能够执政的政党。

revisions.source: Hopefully, Connally can help you win Texas. Even if he's conservative on some issues, he's also a big time insider and a long-time Democrat.
revisions.zh: 希望康纳利能帮你赢下得克萨斯州。即使他在某些议题上保守，他也仍是个资深圈内人，并曾长期是民主党人。
